Placemaker.Feature.volleyball.Tooltip: A 16 × 8 m sand volleyball court with a net, run-off sand and benches for spectators.
Placemaker.Feature.basketball.Tooltip: An asphalt basketball half-court with a hoop facing the path, optionally fenced and floodlit.
Placemaker.Feature.tableTennis.Tooltip: Outdoor ping-pong tables on a paved pad, with benches at the ends.
Placemaker.Feature.chess.Tooltip: Chess tables on paving under a shelter or shade trees, optionally with a giant board.
Placemaker.Feature.fitness.Tooltip: Outdoor gym equipment on a soft surface: a cluster, a calisthenics row or a ring.
Placemaker.Feature.splashPad.Tooltip: A round paved pad with water jets for children, ringed by benches for the parents.
Placemaker.Feature.bandstand.Tooltip: A bandstand at the end of a lawn with arcs of benches, or a gazebo in a ring of flowerbeds.
Placemaker.Feature.dogRun.Tooltip: A fenced dog run with a gate towards the path, agility items, benches and dog bins.
Placemaker.Feature.noticeboard.Tooltip: A community noticeboard or park map with a bench, a bin and a lamp, by default near an entrance.
Placemaker.AddOn.Volleyball.Name: Volleyball pit
Placemaker.AddOn.Volleyball.lines.Toolti: Marking decals at the court's base lines (when marking decals are installed).
Placemaker.AddOn.Volleyball.Issue.Smalle: The volleyball court was made smaller than 16 × 8 m to fit.
Placemaker.AddOn.Basketball.Name: Basketball court
Placemaker.AddOn.Basketball.court.Toolti: A half-court with one hoop (15 × 14 m) or a full court with two (28 × 15 m, needs a long space).
Placemaker.AddOn.Basketball.lines.Toolti: Marking decals at the key and the centre circle (when marking decals are installed).
Placemaker.AddOn.Basketball.fence.Toolti: A fence round the court with one gate towards the path.
Placemaker.AddOn.Basketball.Issue.Half: A full court does not fit here; a half-court was built.
Placemaker.AddOn.TableTennis.Name: Table tennis
Placemaker.AddOn.TableTennis.shade.Toolt: One shade tree off a corner, away from the play space.
Placemaker.AddOn.Chess.Name: Outdoor chess
Placemaker.AddOn.Chess.giant.Tooltip: A 5 × 5 m board laid in the paving with benches for the players.
Placemaker.AddOn.Chess.shade.Tooltip: A shelter over the tables when one is installed, otherwise two shade trees.
Placemaker.AddOn.Fitness.Name: Fitness stations
Placemaker.AddOn.Fitness.layout.Tooltip: An outdoor gym cluster, a calisthenics row along one side, or a ring of stations facing outwards.
Placemaker.AddOn.Fitness.surface.Tooltip: A rubber, bark or gravel surface under the equipment.
Placemaker.AddOn.SplashPad.Name: Splash pad
Placemaker.AddOn.SplashPad.shade.Tooltip: Two shade trees on the side away from the path.
Placemaker.AddOn.Bandstand.Name: Bandstand
Placemaker.AddOn.Bandstand.kind.Tooltip: A bandstand plays to a lawn of benches; a gazebo sits in the middle of a ring of flowerbeds.
Placemaker.AddOn.Bandstand.rows.Tooltip: Arcs of benches facing the bandstand (all round a gazebo).
Placemaker.AddOn.Bandstand.flowers.Toolt: A ring of flowerbeds round the structure, open towards the audience.
Placemaker.AddOn.DogRun.Name: Dog run
Placemaker.AddOn.DogRun.agility.Tooltip: Jumps, tunnels and weave poles spread over the run.
Placemaker.AddOn.DogRun.smallDogs.Toolti: A fenced-off third of the run for small dogs.
Placemaker.AddOn.DogRun.amenities.Toolti: Dog bins and drinking posts by the gate.
Placemaker.AddOn.Noticeboard.Name: Noticeboard
